recognize_zh: 這是胸部電腦斷層軸切肺窗影像，箭頭指向右肺一區血管紋路稀少、較透亮的區域（區域性灌流減少，類似 Westermark sign）；肺窗無法看清肺動脈內的血栓充填缺損，需搭配縱膈窗 CTPA 判讀。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT displayed in lung window at the level of the main bronchi
Arrow indicates a region of the right lung with relative hyperlucency and reduced vascular markings (regional oligemia)
Mild dependent posterior ground-glass density bilaterally
No consolidation, pleural effusion or pneumothorax evident on this slice
Pulmonary arterial filling defects cannot be assessed in this lung window
describe_en: Axial contrast-enhanced chest CT image in lung window shows an area of relative hyperlucency with attenuated vascular markings in the right lung (arrow), suggesting regional oligemia, with mild bilateral dependent ground-glass density and no consolidation, effusion or pneumothorax. These parenchymal findings are indirect and nonspecific; in the appropriate clinical context they are suggestive of pulmonary embolism with mosaic/regional hypoperfusion, and confirmation requires demonstration of intraluminal filling defects on CT pulmonary angiography in mediastinal window. A single slice limits assessment.

ddx.vs: Emphysema shows areas of low attenuation without visible walls and with destroyed parenchyma, usually upper-lobe predominant, rather than oligemia with preserved parenchyma.

ddx.dx: Air trapping from small airway disease
ddx.vs: Air trapping produces mosaic attenuation that accentuates on expiratory CT, whereas vascular mosaic perfusion does not change and vessels are small in the lucent areas.
CTEPH shows mosaic perfusion with webs, bands, enlarged central pulmonary arteries and bronchial collaterals.
